node.description: Identity and commissioning data of the Matter node.

network.description: How the node is reached on the network.

state.description: Where the service keeps its state (fabrics, keys, counters).

bridge.description:
The bridge role. The section's presence enables the role. It needs a build with the Cargo
feature `role-bridge`.

title: matter-rs configuration
description:
The configuration file of matter-rs.

One TOML file configures the service. Configuration and state are kept apart: the service
never writes to this file, and everything it learns at run time lives in the state directory.

vendor_id.description: Vendor id announced by the node. The default is the test vendor id `0xFFF1`.

product_id.description: Product id announced by the node.

serial_number.description: Serial number announced by the node, if any.

passcode.description:
Setup passcode for commissioning: 1 to 99999998, without the trivial values the Matter
specification forbids. A secret: write it here, or read it with `{ env = "NAME" }` or
`{ file = "PATH" }`.

discriminator.description: Discriminator that commissioners use to find the node, 0 to 4095.

NodeSection.description: Identity and commissioning data of the Matter node.

anyOf.description: The secret written into the configuration file itself.
The secret is read from an environment variable.
The secret is read from a file.

SecretValue.description: A secret: the value itself, `{ env = "NAME" }` to read it from an environment variable, or `{ file = "PATH" }` to read it from a file (surrounding whitespace is ignored).

env.description: Name of the environment variable that holds the secret.

EnvSource.description: Names the environment variable that holds a secret.

file.description:
Path of the file that holds the secret. A relative path is relative to the directory of
the configuration file.

FileSource.description: Names the file that holds a secret.

interface.description: Network interface to use, by name. All interfaces when absent.

port.description: UDP port of the Matter protocol.

NetworkSection.description: How the node is reached on the network.

dir.description:
State directory. A relative path is relative to the directory of the configuration file.
When absent: `/var/lib/matter-rs` for root and `$XDG_STATE_HOME/matter-rs` (or
`~/.local/state/matter-rs`) otherwise on Linux; `%ProgramData%\matter-rs` when elevated and
`%LOCALAPPDATA%\matter-rs` otherwise on Windows.

StateSection.description: Where the service keeps its state.

journald.description: Log to the systemd journal. Linux only; ignored with a warning elsewhere.

enabled.description: Run the bridge role. Set to `false` to switch the role off without removing the section.

AdapterConfig.description: One adapter instance: `kind` selects the adapter, the other keys belong to it.
